name: small_baseline
description: Baseline with small non-reasoning model (llama3.2 3B). No debate strategy overrides.

name: small_dialectical
description: Dialectical debate for structural phases with small model. Tests whether structured disagreement helps a weak model.

name: small_socratic
description: Socratic questioning for conceptual phases with small model. Tests whether question-driven probing helps a weak model.

name: small_mixed
description: Best-of-each strategy per phase with small model. Tests whether per-phase strategy optimization compensates for weak model.

name: small_llm_only_naive
description: LLM-only naive baseline with small model. Single comprehensive prompt.

name: small_llm_only_modular
description: LLM-only modular baseline with small model. CQ grouping by theme.

name: small_llm_only_iterative
description: LLM-only iterative baseline with small model. Theme-by-theme processing.

name: small_llm_only_adaptive
description: LLM-only adaptive baseline with small model. LLM decides scope.
